patches.now: pip install --quiet dbt-core dbt-postgres && dbt seed
patches.reason: dbt is not installed in the clean python:3.11-slim image. Installing dbt-core plus an adapter (dbt-postgres as a common default) via pip puts the dbt executable on PATH so the original `dbt seed` can run. If the project uses a different warehouse, swap the adapter (e.g. dbt-duckdb, dbt-snowflake) to match its profiles.yml.

patches.was: pip install --quiet dbt-core dbt-postgres && dbt seed
patches.now: pip install --quiet dbt-core dbt-duckdb && dbt seed
patches.reason: The profile uses the duckdb adapter, but the earlier command installed dbt-postgres, which doesn't provide dbt.adapters.duckdb. The adapter package for DuckDB is dbt-duckdb, and it pulls in a compatible dbt-core. I didn't run a search or test this command. It also assumes the jaffle_shop_duckdb project and its profiles.yml are in the current directory.

The error's own usage line, `jafgen [OPTIONS] [years]`, shows that `years` is a positional argument and not a `--years` option. So the command is `jafgen 6`. I didn't run it or check any docs, so this comes only from the usage text.
